editorial:
Imagine you are desperate to have a baby, but nothing is working. You make one bad choice during a wild night out with a stranger, and suddenly your life turns into a nightmare. You will follow a woman who thinks she finally got her miracle, only to find out the guy she slept with is not just a random stranger. He is obsessed and will do anything to make sure he is the father. The movie feels like a slow-burn trap where the tension builds up until you are practically shouting at the screen for the characters to get out of there.

The acting is solid and makes the scary parts feel real. While the middle part of the film drags a bit, the ending hits hard and keeps you guessing. If you love stories about obsession and secrets, you should definitely check this out. Since it is a smaller film, you might want to look for a digital rental on Apple TV or see if it is streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you love owning your movies, adding the Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this creepy gem forever.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a shocking reveal about the stranger's true identity and his plan. After a scary game of cat and mouse, the woman realizes the man has been manipulating her entire life. In the final struggle, the truth about the baby's father comes out in a violent way. It wraps up with a dark twist that shows just how far a crazy person will go to claim something that is not theirs.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers with a dark twist.
